run_task_runner: run the TaskRunner to schedule and execute all registered data generators and job listeners
register_data_generators: register a list of DataGenerator instances with the TaskRunner for scheduled execution
register_job_listeners: register a list of JobListener instances with the TaskRunner to monitor job progress
check_is_finished: check if all registered data generators and job listeners have completed their tasks
get_job_manage_util: get the Recorder job management utility from the TaskRunner for accessing job metadata
